parameters.note: Tallac Lake is a small alpine lake on the north slopes of Mount Tallac in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), within the Lake Tahoe basin (Taylor Creek / Fallen Leaf Lake drainage) but well upstream of the 'first lake' — so the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152), which reaches only flowing tributaries upstream to the first lake, plus the lake within 300 ft of tributary mouths) does not apply to the lake body itself. The lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
